title: Detect an expired or revoked key and guide the replacement
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. A 401 after a working history means rotation: say so, offer 'susi keys add' with the vendor pre-filled, and keep everything else untouched. Tests zc_rotation_prompt_*.
